description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class GatewayCommandTimeoutException, used to indicate that a command has timed out in a system related to Eclipse Ditto. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements GatewayException, providing constructors, builder pattern, and JSON deserialization methods specific to this exception.
